_: The contrast partner to mario-jump. Mario's rule fits on four lines, so that decision was an upper-bound check on the pipeline, not a use for it. This one is a moderation call a community actually argues about: where sarcasm aimed at a person who was attacked first stops being allowed, and where a prior strike should count. Nobody can write that rule down, and everybody can answer one case at a time. Bucketing a real comment into the codes below is the caller's job - a person, a classifier, whatever the site already has - and is not proven here. tone, target and history each have three legal values in two bits, so code 3 in any of them is illegal and the circuit answers it with keep + review = 1 by construction.
name: comment-hold
scene: A public discussion forum. Comments are visible to everyone by default. Moderators can leave a comment alone, fold it behind a click, or take it down. The forum wants people to argue freely without driving anyone away.
question: What should be done with this comment?

tone.raw: how the comment is written, ignoring whether its content is right; 3 is unused

values.0: calmly stated, no heat in it

target.raw: who or what the comment is aimed at; 3 is unused

values.1: aimed at an argument someone made

provoked.raw: 1 when the comment is a direct reply to a comment that attacked this author

values.0: unprompted; nobody attacked this author first
values.1: a reply to a comment that attacked this author

history.raw: the author's standing on the forum before this comment; 3 is unused

values.0: a new account with no history
values.1: a long-standing member who has never been moderated
values.2: an author who has had a comment taken down before

stakes.raw: 1 when a reader acting on the comment could be harmed (money, health, safety)

values.0: an ordinary topic; nothing turns on being wrong
values.1: advice a reader might act on, where being wrong could cost them money or health

choices.keep: leave the comment as it is
choices.fold: fold it behind a click, so it stays readable but is not in everyone's face
